title: His sister Irene and his mother
summary: Howard describes sister Irene White, a classical singer who died young, and his mother who played piano and organ.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was just reading through this article that -- from the British magazine -- and it mentions some things here period that we don't have on tape yet. It mentions that your sister who sang.
My sister did sing.
What is her name?
What is her name? Irene White.
It says here at this point, this published in the fifties, that she's still singing. Is that
right?

Oh, she sang classics.

I guess so.
A short career.

My mother did. You know, I forgot that?
